            # candidate nodes from route i: first two + last two (deterministic, at most 4)
            cand_pos = []
            cand_pos.append(0)
            if mi >= 2:
                cand_pos.append(1)
            if mi >= 2:
                cand_pos.append(mi - 2)
            cand_pos.append(mi - 1)
            # unique and in original order
            seen = set()
            cand_pos2 = []
            for p in cand_pos:
                if p < 0 or p >= mi:
                    continue
                if p not in seen:
                    seen.add(p)
                    cand_pos2.append(p)
            cand_pos = sorted(cand_pos2)

            old_cost_i = route_cost(ri)

            for rem_pos in cand_pos:
                x = ri[rem_pos]
                if li - demands[x] < 0:
                    continue

                rest_i = ri[:rem_pos] + ri[rem_pos + 1:]
                old_cost_rest_i = route_cost(rest_i)

                order_j = sorted(range(n), key=lambda jj: (loads[jj], jj))
                for j in order_j:
                    if j == i:
                        continue
                    rj = routes[j]
                    lj = loads[j]
                    if not can_add(lj, x):
                        continue

                    old_cost_j = route_cost(rj)

                    if not rj:
                        new_rj = [x]
                        delta = (old_cost_rest_i + route_cost(new_rj)) - (old_cost_i + old_cost_j)
                        if delta < best_global_delta:
                            best_global_delta = delta
                            best_move = (i, j, x, rem_pos, 0)
                        continue

                    m = len(rj)

                    # iterate insertion positions with deterministic prioritization
                    pred_costs = []
                    for pos in range(m + 1):
                        if pos == 0:
                            pc = matrix[depot][x]
                            sc = matrix[x][rj[0]]
                        elif pos == m:
                            pc = matrix[rj[m - 1]][x]
                            sc = matrix[x][depot]
                        else:
                            pc = matrix[rj[pos - 1]][x]
                            sc = matrix[x][rj[pos]]
                        pred_costs.append((pc + sc, pos))
                    pred_costs.sort(key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1]))

                    for _, pos in pred_costs:
                        if pos == 0:
                            new_rj = [x] + rj
                        elif pos == m:
                            new_rj = rj + [x]
                        else:
                            new_rj = rj[:pos] + [x] + rj[pos:]
                        delta = (old_cost_rest_i + route_cost(new_rj)) - (old_cost_i + old_cost_j)
                        if delta < best_global_delta:
                            best_global_delta = delta
                            best_move = (i, j, x, rem_pos, pos)

        if best_move is None:
            break

        i, j, x, rem_pos, ins_pos = best_move

        ri = routes[i]
        routes[i] = ri[:rem_pos] + ri[rem_pos + 1:]
        loads[i] -= demands[x]
        if not routes[i]:
            routes.pop(i)
            loads.pop(i)
            # indices shift if i < j
            if j > i:
                j -= 1

        rj = routes[j]
        if not rj:
            routes[j] = [x]
        else:
            m = len(rj)
            if ins_pos <= 0:
                routes[j] = [x] + rj
            elif ins_pos >= m:
                routes[j] = rj + [x]
            else:
                routes[j] = rj[:ins_pos] + [x] + rj[ins_pos:]
        loads[j] += demands[x]

    # --- deterministic optional merge of adjacent-feasible routes (one sweep), kept ---
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        n = len(routes)
        best_delta = 0
        best_pair = None
        for i in range(n):
            if not routes[i]:
                continue
            li = loads[i]
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j or not routes[j]:
                    continue
                if li + loads[j] > capacity:
                    continue
                new_r = routes[i] + routes[j]
                delta = route_cost(new_r) - (route_cost(routes[i]) + route_cost(routes[j]))
                if delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_pair = (i, j)
        if best_pair is not None:
            i, j = best_pair
            routes[i] = routes[i] + routes[j]
            loads[i] += loads[j]
            routes.pop(j)
            loads.pop(j)
            changed = True

    return routes
